about: Every Weekly Gecko Notes slug ever built into the catalog, in the order it was first built. The ledger in the database is keyed on the slug, so a slug here is never renamed, reused or removed. pnpm build:weekly-notes adds new slugs. To withdraw a note, delete its file, renumber the rest and add its slug to withdrawn. See docs/planning/weekly-notes-2026-10.md, section 6.
